updates.text: All 80 defensive snaps at safety with seven solo tackles, including the tackles on Foles's 10-yard runs in the first and fourth quarters, Sproles's 9-yard run before the half and Celek's 11-yard catch to the 4 on Philadelphia's first touchdown drive; the play-by-play records no coverage on the long completions. A long-term lower-extremity injury was logged at the end of Philadelphia's third overtime possession at 2:27 and he was removed: out, projected return in 95 days (December 11), reassessment September 14 ([medical record](career/2014/Team_Operations/Medical/incidents/dwight_lowery_2014-09-07.md)). His roster disposition is Caldwell's with the user and the Week 2 place is Stone's after the September 8 review; the secondary captaincy is unchanged.
updates.source: Source: [Week 1 game record](career/2014/Regular_Season/Games/Week_01/output.md) and its public receipt. This coaching update preserves the opening grades above.

updates.text: Examined Monday with the September 7 instruction unchanged (out, long term; projected return December 11); placed on reserve/injured with the club's one 2014 return designation by Caldwell on Stone's recommendation: no practice before October 20, no return to the active list before November 3, medical clearance controlling after that. He remains the secondary's captain while under contract; Trawick starts next to Rambo for Week 2 and the secondary echo was built around Daryl Smith's relay this week. No football finding attaches to the injury.

short.text: Dwight Lowery has been a viable NFL starter at safety for Jacksonville, starting beside Bacarri Rambo in 2013 and dressing for all {{2013.regular.games}} regular-season games and {{2013.playoffs.games:words}} playoff games. He steadies the coverage with his communication, positioning and recognition of route combinations, and in 2013 camp he was the cleanest and most stabilizing communicator among the safeties. His anticipation and clean operation make up for ordinary recovery speed, and his man coverage in the slot is below a starter's standard.

transactions.text: Signed a four-year contract with Jacksonville
Placed on reserve/injured, designated for return, by Jacksonville
